characters.name: Salieri
characters.description: 中年男子，深色头发向后梳成马尾，身穿黑色或深棕色外套配白色蕾丝领巾，神情阴郁嫉妒

characters.name: Mozart
characters.description: 年轻男子，金色卷发或戴白色假发，穿着华丽但有时凌乱的宫廷服装，表情丰富多变

characters.name: Old Salieri
characters.description: 老年男子，灰白长发凌乱，身穿暗红色丝绒睡袍，坐在轮椅上，面容枯槁

characters.name: Priest
characters.description: 中年男子，身穿白色法衣配紫色圣带，作为倾听者出现

characters.name: Constance
characters.description: 年轻女子，深色卷发，常穿蓝色或浅色长裙，佩戴帽子，神情忧虑

characters.name: Emperor Joseph II
characters.description: 中年男子，白发向后梳，身穿绿色军装或白色礼服，佩戴勋章和红白绶带

characters.name: Courtier 1
characters.description: 肥胖男子，灰色卷发，身穿深色外套和花纹马甲，常与另一位朝臣在一起

characters.name: Courtier 2
characters.description: 戴眼镜的男子，灰色卷发，身穿蓝色外套，常与Courtier 1在一起

characters.name: Opera Singer
characters.description: 金发女子，妆容浓艳，身穿华丽的白色歌剧戏服，头戴夸张假发

characters.name: Servant
characters.description: 年轻女子，头戴白色软帽，身穿朴素女仆装

props.name: Candelabra
props.description: 多支蜡烛的金属烛台，用于照明

props.name: Harpsichord
props.description: 木制键盘乐器，用于演奏和作曲

props.name: Sheet Music
props.description: 写有乐谱的纸张，散落在桌上或被手持

props.name: Black Mask
props.description: 全脸黑色面具，带有宽檐帽，神秘人物佩戴

props.name: Crucifix
props.description: 墙上的耶稣受难像十字架

props.name: Pastry
props.description: 精致的糕点甜食，摆放在银盘或瓷碗中

props.name: Horse Carriage
props.description: 由马匹牵引的封闭式马车

locations.name: Dark Mansion Interior
locations.description: 昏暗的室内楼梯和走廊，烛光摇曳，装饰古典

locations.name: Snowy Courtyard
locations.description: 夜晚积雪的室外庭院，有人搬运担架

locations.name: Asylum Ward
locations.description: 简陋的病房，地面铺草，病人穿白衣

locations.name: Salieri Study
locations.description: 书房，有书桌、羽笔和窗户，光线较暗

locations.name: Opera Stage
locations.description: 剧院舞台，有布景、台阶和华丽灯光

locations.name: Palace Hall
locations.description: 宏伟的宫殿大厅，挂满壁画，铺红地毯，有管风琴或大键琴

locations.name: Garden Pergola
locations.description: 户外葡萄架下的餐桌，绿植环绕

locations.name: Ballroom
locations.description: 宽敞的舞厅，水晶吊灯，众人跳舞

locations.name: Dining Room
locations.description: 摆满丰盛食物的餐厅，墙上有猎物标本装饰

locations.name: Corridor
locations.description: 宫殿内的长走廊，铺地毯，有盆栽

locations.name: Audience Hall
locations.description: 坐满贵族观众的厅堂，用于听音乐会

locations.name: Emperor's Private Room
locations.description: 皇帝用餐或接见的房间，装饰奢华

locations.name: Bedroom
locations.description: 卧室，有华丽的床和梳妆台

locations.name: Street
locations.description: 鹅卵石街道，有马车和行人

locations.name: Outdoor Concert Venue
locations.description: 户外广场，有管弦乐队和观众席

scenes.scene_purpose: Establish dark atmosphere and servants entering mansion

visual_segments.action: Black screen transitions to a dark exterior shot of a carriage wheel.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut from exterior to interior staircase

visual_segments.action: Two servants carrying candelabras ascend a grand wooden staircase in a dimly lit hall.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to a different room with fireplace

visual_segments.action: Servants walk through a large room with a fireplace towards a door.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to close up of old man on floor
New scene focus on old man

visual_segments.action: An old man sits on the floor bleeding from the neck; servants look on in shock.
Couples waltz in a brightly lit ballroom with chandeliers.
Men carry the old man on a stretcher through snow towards a carriage; credits appear.
Patients in white gowns sit or stand in a corridor; guards watch.
Old Salieri sits at a desk writing with a quill; he gestures while speaking to someone off-screen.
A female singer in white costume performs on stage; a man in black coat watches intently from the audience.
Priest listens solemnly; Old Salieri continues speaking.
Young Mozart plays harpsichord blindfolded before cardinals.

prev_boundary.evidence: Same scene, wider angle showing audience

visual_segments.action: Wide shot shows cardinals applauding; Mozart stands and plays violin.
Family eats under pergola; Mozart chokes on food, woman rushes to help.
Salieri walks through crowded court; people bow to Emperor but ignore him.
Servants carry trays of food past Salieri; he looks around anxiously.

prev_boundary.evidence: Still in same sequence, needs split due to duration > 15s

visual_segments.action: Salieri stands in doorway watching servants pass; door closes.

prev_boundary.evidence: Door opens to reveal dining room

visual_segments.action: Salieri peeks into dining room filled with elaborate desserts.
Close-ups of cakes, chocolates, and roasted birds on silver platters.
Salieri reaches for chocolate; Constance hides under table.

camera.composition_note: Split focus between table and hiding spot

prev_boundary.evidence: Camera position change to floor level

visual_segments.action: Constance crawls under table; feet of others visible nearby.
Constance emerges from other side of table.
Emperor and clergy enter; guests bow.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to intimate interaction on floor

visual_segments.action: Man and woman embrace on floor; he helps her up; they look startled.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Salieri behind dessert display

visual_segments.action: Salieri peers over dessert table with shocked expression.
Man runs down corridor past guards.
Large audience in powdered wigs sits listening; Emperor present.
Mozart conducts energetically; audience watches; Salieri looks jealous.
Mozart bows; leaves room; Salieri follows.
Guests depart; Salieri stands alone looking at score.
Emperor eats pastry; courtiers stand around.
Salieri plays harpsichord and writes music.
Servants powder Mozart's wig; he laughs in mirror.
Mozart enters; greets Emperor; presents sheet music.
Courtiers laugh; Mozart looks confused then amused.
Mozart plays piano; Emperor reads score; courtiers watch.
Emperor comments on music; Mozart reacts; Salieri observes.
Mozart leaves; Salieri stays behind looking thoughtful.
Salieri stares intensely; cuts to crucifix; cuts to opera singer.
Singer performs; audience applauds; Mozart conducts.
Guards line up; performers receive flowers; Mozart talks to singer.
Emperor congratulates Mozart; Salieri watches from shadows.
Woman at vanity; Salieri enters; Mozart appears.
Salieri kneels before crucifix; shadow looms.
Bishop blesses congregation; people kiss ring.
Emperor on horse meets Salieri on path.
Man enters room; woman sits by window.
Salieri offers bowl of pastries to woman; she eats one.
Woman looks at sheet music; Salieri takes it; she pleads.
Salieri writes at desk by candlelight.
Servant enters with tray; Salieri looks up.
Constance stands in the bedroom and begins to unfasten and remove her outer dress, revealing her undergarments.
Constance continues to remove her dress and then bends down to take off her stockings, standing in her corset and petticoat.

camera.composition_note: Focus on the action of removing stockings

visual_segments.action: Constance stands fully in her undergarments in the dimly lit bedroom.
Hand throws papers into fire.
Dogs run through room; people react.
Mozart teaches child piano; parents watch; dogs play.
Mozart argues with father-in-law; storms out.
Guests in masks dance; black-masked figure watches.
Mozart writes music on green pool table surface.
Man blocks door; woman pleads; argument ensues.
Salieri offers plate of food to servant.
Furniture carried out; family loads carriage.
Mozart plays piano outdoors; orchestra accompanies.
Couple rides in carriage through streets.
Servant shows rooms; man inspects furniture.
Man picks up quill; looks at scattered sheet music.
Mozart presents himself to Emperor again.
Singers rehearse; Mozart directs; woman adjusts wig.
Men discuss around table; Salieri listens.
Emperor arrives; audience settles; performance begins.
Audience cheers; Mozart bows; Emperor applauds.
Musicians congratulate Mozart; he looks happy.
Statue appears; fire effects; actor drinks wine.
Mozart enters room looking disheveled.
Constance waits by door; looks worried.
Man reads score by candlelight; laughs.
Mozart kisses sleeping child; wife watches.
Mozart walks down hall with candelabra.
Black masked figure stands in doorway; Mozart looks terrified.
Mozart runs away; wife screams.
Queen of Night on moon; audience amazed.
Mozart collapses; carried to bed; Salieri visits.
Salieri writes as Mozart dictates from bed.
Carriage moves through dark landscape.
Carriage stops; people disembark in rain.
Constance enters empty room; looks around sadly.
Constance finds Mozart dead in bed; cries.
Constance lies on body; weeps.
Salieri stands watching; Constance holds score.

prev_boundary.evidence: Back to old man and priest

visual_segments.action: Old Salieri finishes story; priest absolves him.
